pairs.target: dìshíèrtiān de yǔ cóng wǔhòu xià dào tiānhēi , shàichǎng jī le shuǐ , pà wò bào zhe qiú zài ménkǒu zhàn le yíhuìer , yòu bào huílái .
pairs.english: Rain fell from afternoon till dark on the twelfth day. With the drying yard flooded, Pavo stood in the doorway holding his ball, then brought it back.
pairs.hanzi: 第十二天的雨从午后下到天黑，晒场积了水，帕沃抱着球在门口站了一会儿，又抱回来。

pairs.target: tā bǎ qiú sāijìn tǎ wéi chuángdǐ , shuō zìjǐ de chuángdǐ lòushuǐ .
pairs.english: He shoved the ball under Tavi's bed, saying it leaked under his own.
pairs.hanzi: 他把球塞进塔维床底，说自己的床底漏水。

pairs.target: " nà lòu xiàlái de shì wǒ de shuǐ ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: “So the water that leaks is mine?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: “那漏下来的是我的水？”塔维问。

pairs.target: pà wò méi tīngjiàn , yǐjīng pǎo qù zhǎo pén le .
pairs.english: Pavo didn't hear; he'd already run for a basin.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃没听见，已经跑去找盆了。

pairs.target: wǎnfàn hòu , xǐyī yuàn nàbiān yǒurén qiāokōng mùtǒng .
pairs.english: After supper someone beat an empty wooden tub in the laundry courtyard.
pairs.hanzi: 晚饭后，洗衣院那边有人敲空木桶。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi yòu shì jiào rén bāndōngxī , dào le ménkǒu cái kànjiàn liàngyīshéng shàng guà zhe yíkuài báibù , bù hòu liàng zhe dēng , qiánmiàn bǎi le sānpái zhǎngdèng .
pairs.english: Tavi thought they wanted help carrying things again. At the entrance he saw a white sheet on the clothesline, a lamp behind it and three rows of benches in front.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为又是叫人搬东西，到了门口才看见晾衣绳上挂着一块白布，布后亮着灯，前面摆了三排长凳。

pairs.target: yǒurén bǎ yígèzhǐ zuò de réntóu jǔ qǐlái , yǐngzi luò zài bù shàng , bízi cháng dé kuài pèngdào xiàbā .
pairs.english: Someone raised a paper head, its shadow on the sheet showing a nose almost long enough to touch its chin.
pairs.hanzi: 有人把一个纸做的人头举起来，影子落在布上，鼻子长得快碰到下巴。

pairs.target: " jīnwǎn bù xǐyīfu ? " pà wò wèn . yígè gāoniánjí gūniáng cóng bù hòu tàn chū liǎn .
pairs.english: “No washing tonight?” Pavo asked. An older girl poked her face from behind the sheet.
pairs.hanzi:
“今晚不洗衣服？”帕沃问。
一个高年级姑娘从布后探出脸。

pairs.target: " xǐ . děng guówáng sǐ le yǐhòu . " pà wò lìkè zhàn le qiánpái .
pairs.english: “Yes. After the king dies.” Pavo promptly claimed the front row.
pairs.hanzi:
“洗。等国王死了以后。”
帕沃立刻占了前排。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhǎodào mǐlā hé yīwén shí , tāmen zhèng wèile zuò nǎér zhēngzhí .
pairs.english: When Tavi found Mira and Iven, they were arguing about where to sit.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维找到米拉和伊文时，他们正为了坐哪儿争执。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō hòupái kàn dé quán , mǐlā shuō qiánpái kàndéqīng .
pairs.english: Iven wanted the whole view from the back; Mira wanted the clear view at the front.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说后排看得全，米拉说前排看得清。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ dèngzǐ wǎng wūyánxià nuó , yòu yòng pà wò dì lái de pòbù cā qù shuǐ . liǎnggè rén zhōngyú yìqǐ zuòxià .
pairs.english: Tavi moved the bench under the eaves and wiped off the water with a rag Pavo passed him. Both finally sat together.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把凳子往屋檐下挪，又用帕沃递来的破布擦去水。两个人终于一起坐下。

pairs.target: xìshuō de shì yígè diū le míngzì de guówáng .
pairs.english: The play concerned a king who'd lost his name.
pairs.hanzi: 戏说的是一个丢了名字的国王。

pairs.target: bù hòu liǎngmíng xuéshēng lún zhe shuōhuà , shuí nádào wángguān shuí jiù zuò guówáng ;
pairs.english: Behind the sheet two students took turns speaking; whoever held the crown played king.
pairs.hanzi: 布后两名学生轮着说话，谁拿到王冠谁就做国王；

pairs.target: lìngwài de rén jǔ zhe fángzi , chuán hé yìbǎ dà dé búxiànghuà de sháozǐ .
pairs.english: Others held houses, a boat, and an absurdly large spoon.
pairs.hanzi: 另外的人举着房子、船和一把大得不像话的勺子。

pairs.target: guówáng qiāokāi sān jiāmén , biérén dōu shuō bú rènshi tā , zuìhòu dào le chúfáng , chúniáng zhī wèn tā huì buhuì xiāo càigēn .
pairs.english: The king knocked at three houses, where nobody knew him, and finally reached a kitchen whose cook only asked if he could peel roots.
pairs.hanzi: 国王敲开三家门，别人都说不认识他，最后到了厨房，厨娘只问他会不会削菜根。

pairs.target: " wǒ yǒu sānshízuò chéng ! " jiān sǎngzi zài bù hòu hǎn . " nà nǐ xiāo sānshí gēn . "
pairs.english: “I have thirty cities!” cried a shrill voice behind the sheet. “Then peel thirty roots.”
pairs.hanzi:
“我有三十座城！”尖嗓子在布后喊。
“那你削三十根。”

pairs.target: yuànzi lǐ de rén xiào qǐlái . tǎ wéi méi rěnzhù , xiàoshēng bǐ zìjǐ yǐwéi de dà , qiánpái yǒurén huítóu , tā gǎnjǐn bǎ liǎn wǎng lǐngzǐ lǐ suō .
pairs.english: The courtyard laughed. Tavi couldn't help laughing louder than he expected; someone turned from the front row, and he hurriedly tucked his face into his collar.
pairs.hanzi: 院子里的人笑起来。塔维没忍住，笑声比自己以为的大，前排有人回头，他赶紧把脸往领子里缩。

pairs.target: dēng zài bù hòu zhào chū nuǎn huáng de yíkuài , sìjiǎo réngjiù fāàn .
pairs.english: The lamp made a warm yellow patch behind the sheet, its four corners still dim.
pairs.hanzi: 灯在布后照出暖黄的一块，四角仍旧发暗。

pairs.target: zhǐrén de tuǐ yòng xìxiàn diào zhe , yì zǒu jiù huàng , pèngdào zhuō yán shí shènzhì zhé le yíxià .
pairs.english: The paper figures' legs dangled on thread, wobbling as they walked and even bending against the table edge.
pairs.hanzi: 纸人的腿用细线吊着，一走就晃，碰到桌沿时甚至折了一下。

pairs.target: kě guówáng yì kāikǒu , tǎ wéi háishì huì wàngjì jǔ zhe tā de nà zhī shǒu .
pairs.english: Yet whenever the king spoke, Tavi forgot the hand holding him.
pairs.hanzi: 可国王一开口，塔维还是会忘记举着他的那只手。

pairs.target: yǎn dào guòhé , chēngchuán de zhǐ gān duàn le .
pairs.english: During the river crossing, the boat's paper support broke.
pairs.hanzi: 演到过河，撑船的纸杆断了。

pairs.target: xiǎochuán tíng zài bù zhōngjiān , guówáng bàngè shēnzi diào jìnshuǐ lǐ , bù hòu chuánlái yādī de zhēngchǎo , yǒurén yào jiǎnzǐ , yǒurén wèn jiǎnzǐ wèishénme yě zài chuán lǐ .
pairs.english: The boat stopped mid-sheet, half the king fell into the water, and hushed arguments came from behind: someone wanted scissors; someone asked why those were in the boat too.
pairs.hanzi: 小船停在布中间，国王半个身子掉进水里，布后传来压低的争吵，有人要剪子，有人问剪子为什么也在船里。

pairs.target: yīwén hūrán tì guówáng hǎn : " wǒ yóuguòqù yě néng dāng guówáng ! "
pairs.english: Iven suddenly shouted for the king, “I can swim across and still be king!”
pairs.hanzi: 伊文忽然替国王喊：“我游过去也能当国王！”

pairs.target: bù hòu jìng le yíxià . " huì yóu de shànglái ! " nàge gūniáng shuō .
pairs.english: Silence behind the sheet. “Swimmers, come up!” the girl said.
pairs.hanzi:
布后静了一下。
“会游的上来！”那个姑娘说。

pairs.target: mǐlā zài yīwén bèishàng tuī le yìbǎ . tā huítóu dèng tā , yuànzi lǐ yǐjīng yǒurén gǔzhǎng .
pairs.english: Mira pushed Iven's back. He turned to glare, but people were already applauding.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉在伊文背上推了一把。他回头瞪她，院子里已经有人鼓掌。

pairs.target: tā zhǐhǎo zhàn qǐlái , zǒu dào báibù cèmiàn , xiān hěn tǐmiàndì jū le yì gōng , yòu zhuàng dào le liàngyīshéng .
pairs.english: He had to stand and go beside the sheet, where he bowed with great dignity, then hit the clothesline.
pairs.hanzi: 他只好站起来，走到白布侧面，先很体面地鞠了一躬，又撞到了晾衣绳。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào dé xīgài dōu zài dǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed until his knees shook.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑得膝盖都在抖。

pairs.target: gūniáng bǎ duàn le gān de chuán sāi gěi yīwén , ràng tā cóng hòumiàn tuōzhù , děng bǔ gān de shíhòu tì chuánfū shuō liǎngjù .
pairs.english: The girl gave Iven the broken-supported boat to hold from behind, asking him to speak for the boatman while they repaired it.
pairs.hanzi: 姑娘把断了杆的船塞给伊文，让他从后面托住，等补杆的时候替船夫说两句。

pairs.target: tā qīng qīngsǎngzi , gāng shuōchū " bìxià ", wángguān jiù cóng zhǐrén tóushàng diào le xiàlái .
pairs.english: He cleared his throat; barely had he said “Your Majesty” when the paper king's crown fell off.
pairs.hanzi: 他清清嗓子，刚说出“陛下”，王冠就从纸人头上掉了下来。

pairs.target: " nǐ de màozi yě yào chuánqián . " tā mǎshàng gǎikǒu .
pairs.english: “Your hat needs a fare too,” he corrected himself at once.
pairs.hanzi: “你的帽子也要船钱。”他马上改口。

pairs.target: zhècì lián bù hòu de rén dōu xiào le .
pairs.english: This time even the people behind the sheet laughed.
pairs.hanzi: 这次连布后的人都笑了。

pairs.target: chuán zài tā shǒushàng wāi zhe zǒu , chúniáng de sháozǐ shēnchū lái jiù guówáng , bù xiǎoxīn bǎ màozi tuī dé gèng yuǎn .
pairs.english: The boat wobbled in his hand; the cook's spoon reached out to rescue the king and accidentally pushed the hat farther away.
pairs.hanzi: 船在他手上歪着走，厨娘的勺子伸出来救国王，不小心把帽子推得更远。

pairs.target: mǐlā dīng zhe nàgēn huàngdòng de chuán gān , zhōngyú rěnbúzhù , ràoguòqù bāngmáng .
pairs.english: Watching the wobbling support, Mira finally couldn't bear it and went around to help.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉盯着那根晃动的船杆，终于忍不住，绕过去帮忙。

pairs.target: tā ná xìxiàn bǎ duàn chù chánzhù , jiè gūniáng de zhǐjiǎ yā zhe dǎjié , yòu ràng yīwén bǎshǒu fàng dī , miǎnde guānzhòng zhī kànjiàn yízuò zhǐtou shān .
pairs.english: She bound the break with thread, knotted it against the girl's nail, and told Iven to lower his hand so the audience wouldn't see just a mountain of fingers.
pairs.hanzi: 她拿细线把断处缠住，借姑娘的指甲压着打结，又让伊文把手放低，免得观众只看见一座指头山。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shēnbiān kōng le . tā zuò le yíhuìer , pà wò huítóu chōng tā zhāoshǒu , jiào tā nuó dào qiánpái .
pairs.english: Tavi was alone on the bench. After a while Pavo turned and beckoned him to the front row.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维身边空了。他坐了一会儿，帕沃回头冲他招手，叫他挪到前排。

pairs.target: kě bù hòu hūrán chuánchū yīwén de shēngyīn , shuō zhè tiáo hélǐ hái gāi yǒu yìtiáo dàyú .
pairs.english: But Iven's voice suddenly came from behind the sheet, saying this river ought to have a big fish too.
pairs.hanzi: 可布后忽然传出伊文的声音，说这条河里还该有一条大鱼。

pairs.target: " nǐ lái ! " mǐlā cóng cèbiān cháo tǎ wéi hǎn , " nǐ búshì huì zuò nàge ma ? "
pairs.english: “Come here!” Mira called to Tavi from the side. “Can't you do that thing?”
pairs.hanzi: “你来！”米拉从侧边朝塔维喊，“你不是会做那个吗？”

pairs.target: tā zhīdào tā shuō shénme . zuótiān huà zhuāngzhì huà fán le , tā duì zhe qiáng dēng niē guò yígè zhāngzuǐ de yǐngzi , tā kànjiàn le , shuō xiàng gè quē yá lǎotóu .
pairs.english: He knew what she meant. Bored with drawing the device yesterday, he'd made a gaping shadow by a wall lamp. She'd seen it and called it a toothless old man.
pairs.hanzi: 他知道她说什么。昨天画装置画烦了，他对着墙灯捏过一个张嘴的影子，她看见了，说像个缺牙老头。

pairs.target: tā rào dào bù hòu , xiān wéndào yìgǔ rè dēngyóu wèi , cái kànqīng zhèlǐ jǐ zhe duōshǎo gēbo .
pairs.english: Behind the sheet he smelled hot lamp oil before seeing how many elbows were crammed in there.
pairs.hanzi: 他绕到布后，先闻到一股热灯油味，才看清这里挤着多少胳膊。

pairs.target: yīwén gěi tā ràng le yìdiǎn dìfāng . tā liǎngshǒu jiāodié , mǔzhǐ zhāngkāi , bù shàng lìkè duōchū yígè dà zuǐ .
pairs.english: Iven made room for him. He crossed his hands and opened his thumbs; a huge mouth appeared on the sheet.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文给他让了一点地方。他两手交叠，拇指张开，布上立刻多出一个大嘴。

pairs.target: guówáng bèi yìkǒu tūn le . " búshì xiànzài ! " gūniáng xiǎoshēng jiào .
pairs.english: The king was swallowed whole. “Not now!” the girl whispered urgently.
pairs.hanzi:
国王被一口吞了。
“不是现在！”姑娘小声叫。

pairs.target: yǐjīng wǎn le . pà wò zài wàimiàn pāi zhe tuǐ dàxiào , jǐgè rén gēnzhe hǎn zài lái yícì .
pairs.english: Too late. Outside, Pavo slapped his thighs laughing, and several others shouted for another go.
pairs.hanzi: 已经晚了。帕沃在外面拍着腿大笑，几个人跟着喊再来一次。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng bǎshǒu shōuhuí qù , yīwén què tuō zhe chuán , cóng yú zuǐbiān xiǎoxīn dì ràoguòqù .
pairs.english: Tavi tried to withdraw his hands, but Iven carefully steered the boat around the fish's mouth.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想把手收回去，伊文却托着船，从鱼嘴边小心地绕过去。

pairs.target: " bìxià yǐ dào bǐàn , màozi shàng zài túzhōng . "
pairs.english: “His Majesty has reached the far shore. The hat is still in transit.”
pairs.hanzi: “陛下已到彼岸，帽子尚在途中。”

pairs.target: mǐlā dūn zài dìshàng , xiào dé xì búzhù zuìhòu yígè jié .
pairs.english: Mira crouched on the floor, laughing too hard to tie the last knot.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉蹲在地上，笑得系不住最后一个结。

pairs.target: nà guówáng zhōngyú cóng yú zuǐlǐ dǎotuì chūlái , diū le wángguān , yě diū le yìtiáo zhǐ tuǐ , zhǐhǎo bèi chúniáng de sháozǐ tái zǒu .
pairs.english: The king finally backed out of the fish's mouth, minus crown and one paper leg, and had to be carried off by the cook's spoon.
pairs.hanzi: 那国王终于从鱼嘴里倒退出来，丢了王冠，也丢了一条纸腿，只好被厨娘的勺子抬走。

pairs.target: xì hòulái zěnyàng jiéshù , tǎ wéi méi quán tīng qīng .
pairs.english: Tavi didn't quite hear how the play ended.
pairs.hanzi: 戏后来怎样结束，塔维没全听清。

pairs.target: tāmen bǎ dēng wǎnghòu nuó le xiē , báibù shàng de yú biànxiǎo le , tā fāxiàn zhǐyào dòng yíxià zhǐjiān , jiù néng ràng tā zhuī zhe chuánwěi zǒu .
pairs.english: They moved the lamp back a little, shrinking the fish on the sheet; he found a movement of his fingertips could make it follow the stern.
pairs.hanzi: 他们把灯往后挪了些，白布上的鱼变小了，他发现只要动一下指尖，就能让它追着船尾走。

pairs.target: sànchǎng shí , luò héng bāngmáng tái chángdèng , jīngguò tǎ wéi shēnbiān , hūrán bǎ liǎngzhīshǒu jiāo qǐlái . " zhèyàng ? "
pairs.english: Afterward Lohen helped carry benches. Passing Tavi, he suddenly crossed his hands. “Like this?”
pairs.hanzi:
散场时，洛衡帮忙抬长凳，经过塔维身边，忽然把两只手交起来。
“这样？”

pairs.target: tā zuòchū yígè fāngfāng de yǐngzi . tǎ wéi shuō mǔzhǐ dé sōng yìdiǎn , shēnshǒu bǐ gěi tā kàn .
pairs.english: He made a square shadow. Tavi said to loosen his thumbs and showed him.
pairs.hanzi: 他做出一个方方的影子。塔维说拇指得松一点，伸手比给他看。

pairs.target: yǔ hái zài xià , wūyán dīshuǐ de shēngyīn lǐ , pà wò réng zài xué yīwén nà jù màozi shàng zài túzhōng .
pairs.english: Rain kept falling; amid dripping eaves, Pavo was still imitating Iven's line about the hat in transit.
pairs.hanzi: 雨还在下，屋檐滴水的声音里，帕沃仍在学伊文那句帽子尚在途中。

pairs.target: huí qǐn fáng hòu , tǎ wéi cái xiǎngqǐ chuángdǐ de qiú . wàimiàn nà céng bù guǒrán shī le , tā bǎ tā pěngchūlái , fàngdào pà wò zhěntou biān .
pairs.english: Back in the room Tavi remembered the ball under his bed. Its outer cloth was wet, as expected. He lifted it out and set it beside Pavo's pillow.
pairs.hanzi: 回寝房后，塔维才想起床底的球。外面那层布果然湿了，他把它捧出来，放到帕沃枕头边。
